TEXT:
I was looking up at a dazzling blue sky while 
waiting at the designated place.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
This is what they'd call the perfect weather for a 
date, I guess...

I unintentionally murmured as I stood there feeling 
pretty good.

Why? It's time for our date. And it has nothing to 
do with stuff like otakus and Akiba?!
It's as if this blue sky has given me its blessing...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I'm sorry to keep you waiting, Onii-san.

Tired of waiting, I turned to face that voice, and 
there was my beloved angel.

Due to her divine appearance, people passing by 
couldn't help but turn their heads and stare in awe.

Well, that's a given. With someone as cute as her, 
even I would turn to catch a glimpse.

To think someone like that is my girlfriend... My life is 
complete!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I haven't been waiting that long.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Good... Actually, aren't you a little too early?

Ayase looked up at me with a slightly troubled 
smile.

She held quite a big basket in her hands, but... 
what's inside...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes. It's still ten minutes before the appointed time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I just wanted to see you as soon as possible.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Geez, Onii-san, you always say things like that.

After looking a bit embarrassed, her face red, 
Ayase naturally took my hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Shall we go then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

Ayase is in charge of our date today. Apparently, 
there was a place she wanted to go with me.

Well, I personally don't know this part of town well, 
so I have no choice but to quietly tag along.

With Ayase pulling at my hand, we started walking 
through the Odaiba district.

However, as expected from Odaiba, there are a lot 
of couples here. A lot of them walk around hand in 
hand as well...

Still, just to make things clear, Ayase-tan is still the 
cutest of them all!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What is it? You're just smiling away.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I was just thinking how lucky I am to be dating 
someone as cute as you, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: G-Geez, you can't just blurt out something like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I seriously--

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Onii-san, you're so insincere.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]What?![/font_size]

But I was just being honest that Ayase is the 
cutest in the world...
Maybe I'm getting ahead of myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Onii-san, you're pretty cool too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You're really cool, Onii-san. More than anyone else.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh.

I was left speechless by Ayase's unexpected 
counterattack.

She might've just been doing her part as my 
girlfriend, but Ayase saying that makes me 
extremely happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Well then, let's go look at clothes first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: L-Lead the way.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I'm going to show you around a lot of places, so 
you'd better be prepared.

Seeing Ayase smiling at me, I almost thought I'd 
died and ended up in heaven.
Truly a frightening girl, you are...

As we entered the shopping mall, Ayase went 
straight into one of the shops. Seems like she comes 
here often.
Well, I don't really mind, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This place really isn't for me, huh.

The clothes lined up were, of course, for women. 
Frankly, if not for Ayase, people would probably be 
suspicious of me going in here.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
This store is quite famous, and I often wear their 
clothes in my work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really...
So, I guess Kirino's also been here before?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, aren't these clothes cute?

As I was looking around the shop restlessly, Ayase 
had found some interesting clothes and rushed off 
towards a nearby shelf.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san~! Over here~!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What do you think of this? Or maybe this one...

Ayase looked jubilant as she held up the clothes in 
front of her. And yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-They're fine, I guess?
That was all I could say, really.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
That's not it, Onii-san, what I'm asking is which of 
these do you want to see me in?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, I wouldn't mind either one.

Ayase would look cute in both anyway. Eh, wait, am 
I being tested?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: T-That's not quite it either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Geez, just think about it seriously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-Well... This one?
I pointed at the clothes in Ayase's left hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I see. Wait here for a bit, okay?
Ayase said that and left for a nearby dressing room.
After a short time...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: How does it look? Does it suit me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=44]Amazingly cute![/font_size]

I replied to Ayase with all my energy as she came 
out of the dressing room.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Okay, then I'm getting this one.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright, I'll buy it for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I think it looks good on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san... Thank you very much!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Then I'll wear this for the rest of our date today.

As she said that, Ayase once again entered the 
dressing room.
...No need to stand around here waiting.
Guess I'll go and pay the bill while she's changing.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Huh? The bill...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, I took care of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I'm sorry. It wasn't too expensive, was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't worry about it.

Honestly, it did hurt my wallet quite a bit. But well, 
this is also the boyfriend's responsibility, I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Thank you so very much. Shall we be off then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? You don't want any other clothes?
She had seemed pretty troubled about it earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
It's fine. After all, Onii-san, my goal was to have you 
tell me I looked cute.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase...

What's with this girl? Is she going to sprout wings 
from her back now? Is she really an angel?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ehehe~

Ayase innocently clinging to my arm, I'm honestly 
starting to feel a bit dizzy.

The next place we arrived at was a cafe, which in 
my eyes seemed like quite a classy place.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I've been curious about this cafe for a while now.

Ayase explained as she guided me towards our 
seats.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I read about it in a magazine and thought that I'd 
want to come here someday with you, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm honored.

I'm somehow managing to reply calmly, but on the 
inside, I'm so happy I feel I might burst out 
dancing any moment now.

I mean, she said she wanted to come here with me, 
you know? I can hardly believe I'm actually dating 
Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It seems this cafe is famous for their cheesecake.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then I think I'll have that as well.

I unintentionally narrowed my eyes as I watched 
Ayase's lively face, engrossed in the menu.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Ah, we'll be having lunch after this, so you shouldn't 
eat too much, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I know that.

Looks like I'll be enjoying this day with Ayase to the 
fullest.
